subject: Security attestation renewal — evidence plan, term flexibility & capacity uplift request
messages:
From: Lauren Cheng <lauren.cheng@finovatech.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marco Diaz <marco.diaz@finovatech.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@finovatech.com>
Date: 2028-10-22T08:14:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal plan + SOC2 evidence window (contract up 12/31)

Hi Vanessa —

FinovaTech is kicking off our renewal conversations early. Contract expires 12/31 and security will need an updated attestation for our compliance committee (SOC 2 Type II). Two asks to start:

1) A short runbook listing the specific artifacts you can provide (log retention windows, sample audit reports, access to audit logs).
2) Any available flexibility on the term language for log retention — our counsel may request a 540-day carveout instead of the standard 365 in the current SOW.

We have a capacity question as well: our usage is projected to grow 2.5x starting Q2 next year — if we commit now, can we lock-in dedicated capacity pricing and an expedited evidence handoff?

Would like to set a 30-minute sync this week with your security/ops and procurement. Availability: Wed/Thu afternoon PST.

Thanks,
Lauren
Director, Security & Compliance
FinovaTech

——

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Lauren Cheng <lauren.cheng@finovatech.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Connor Obrien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-10-22T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal plan + SOC2 evidence window (contract up 12/31)

Hi Lauren — thank you for the heads up and timeline. Appreciate the clarity.

High-level response and proposed next steps:

- Evidence matrix: I attached our working draft (redwood_evidence_matrix_v1.xlsx). It maps commonly requested artifacts (SOC 2 report, control test summaries, log export samples, SIEM ingestion notes) to expected delivery windows. We can provide scoped extracts for review within 10 business days for standard items; larger bulk exports (log-level) follow the evidence-onramp plan.

- Retention-term language: we can be pragmatic. For customers requiring >365 days we offer a term addendum that pairs extended retention (e.g., 540d) with a committed capacity/seat uplift or a modest platform fee to cover archive storage. I attached a sketch (draft-amendment-term-capacity.docx) with two options — 540d and 730d — and the corresponding pricing uplift.

- Capacity & pricing: Connor: can you confirm if we can lock dedicated capacity pricing for FinovaTech with a Q2 start date if they sign an amendment by 11/30? Also, Ben, please review whether we can offer an expedited evidence-handling SLA as a short-term service for this renewal.

Propose a 30-min call Thu 10/25 11:00 AM PST. If that works, I’ll send a calendar invite and include our Security SME.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Revenue — Enterprise
Redwood Inference

——
Attachments: redwood_evidence_matrix_v1.xlsx, draft-amendment-term-capacity.docx
From: Connor Obrien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-10-22T11:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal plan + SOC2 evidence window (contract up 12/31)

Vanessa / Ben — quick operational note:

- Dedicated capacity: yes, we can reserve a dedicated pool with a Q2 activation and a guaranteed throughput SLA if the amendment is signed by 11/30. Finance will require a six-month minimum billing commit for the reserved pool to lock the pricing.

- Evidence exports: for a bulk log export (historic 18 months), our Security & Ops can run an extraction pipeline but it needs a 21-business-day window for packaging, validation, and pseudonymization where applicable. We can compress that to 10 business days as an expedited path if we tag it as a one-time professional services engagement (expedite fee applies).

- On retention term: we should avoid open-ended retention obligations; tie the retention extension to a term amendment (e.g., extend retention to 540d for the duration of the contract amendment).

I also attached the log-retention-proposal-FT.pdf with the ops timeline and cost assumptions — Ben, flag any pricing changes.

Connor
Director, Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>

Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Procurement Team <procurement@finovatech.com>
Date: 2028-10-23T09:35:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal plan + SOC2 evidence window (contract up 12/31)

Lauren / team —

Thanks for the request. A few practical options based on internal pricing & procurement constraints:

Option A — 540d retention addendum + committed dedicated capacity (6-mo min billing): 12% platform uplift, one-time evidence expedite fee (10% of monthly committed spend) to guarantee a 10-business-day evidence turnaround.

Option B — 365d default retention with seat uplift to cover projected 2.5x usage: 8% discount on committed capacity if they sign a 12-month capacity commit. Evidence turnaround: standard 21-business-day window, no expedite fee.

Option C — 730d archive (longer-term): requires heavier billing commit (12-mo min + archiving fee), estimated 20% uplift.

Which option matches FinovaTech’s risk tolerance? Vanessa — if they want a firm 540d without the capacity commit, Procurement will push back; we should prepare a tracked amendment with the terms mapped.

I can join Thu 10/25 call to run through numbers.

Best,
Ben Carter
Head of Product GTM
Redwood Inference
From: Lauren Cheng <lauren.cheng@finovatech.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Connor Obrien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>

Date: 2028-10-25T16:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal plan + SOC2 evidence window (contract up 12/31)

Thanks everyone — Thu 11:00 AM PST works for us. Quick answers before the call to keep things moving: 

- FinovaTech prefers Option A (540d) tied to a committed capacity starting Q2. We can accept the six-month billing floor if we get the expedited evidence SLA for initial handoff.

- Procurement: please prepare the PO path — we will target sign by 11/15 to meet your 11/30 amendment deadline.

- On logs: we prefer the 10-business-day expedited export for the initial 18-month sample. After that, we can move to periodic snapshots.

Agenda for Thu: 1) confirm amendment language (Kimberly to propose tracked changes), 2) capacity pricing confirmation (Ben), 3) ops timeline and expedite scope (Connor), 4) PO and DocuSign path (Vanessa).

See you Thu,
Lauren
Director, Security & Compliance
FinovaTech
